full_dataset_size: Everything tabular that is committed to the repo is already here (~2.3 MB, 10 CSVs; the repo also holds ~1.6 MB of GeoJSON and ~30 MB of notebooks/images). The raw inputs described in the README were NEVER committed: airbnb.csv (23 merged Inside Airbnb Boston scrapes, 629 MB raw, 124,730 x 31 cleaned), STRE.csv (23.4 MB, data.boston.gov), STR_apps.csv (300 kB, from Boston DoIT, not public), SAMREF.csv (78.6 MB), bari_props_2019.csv (78.9 MB, Harvard Dataverse), padmapper.csv (47.9 MB, 917,948 x 6, from jefftk.com). Rebuilding airbnb.csv needs the 2015-2020 Boston listings.csv.gz dumps, which are no longer on the Inside Airbnb CDN.
description: Derived panel from a 2020 student capstone on Boston's June-2018 Short-Term Rental Ordinance. The committed tables are aggregates of Inside Airbnb Boston scrapes (35 scrape dates, Oct 2015-Feb 2020) at census-tract and neighbourhood grain per scrape date (listing count, accommodates, licensed share, median/avg nightly price, 30-day availability), plus a matching Padmapper long-term-rental asking-rent panel (Feb 2013-Feb 2020, 85 scrapes), Feb-2020 cross-sections of the city STR registry status counts and BARI parcel attributes by tract, and a listing-level file of 770 listings sharing duplicated licence numbers from the Feb-2020 scrape. For ABNB an analyst would use it as a pre-2023 Boston listing-count and quote-price time series (a city we do not hold) and as a regulation natural-experiment case: listing counts and licensed share before and after the Dec-2019 registration deadline, paired with LTR rents. The raw listing-level 2015-2020 vintages themselves are not in the repo.
issues: The job card's plan (airbnb.csv, STRE.csv, padmapper.csv, STR_apps.csv) could not be followed: none of those raw files were ever committed; only the derived tract/neighbourhood aggregates exist on GitHub. No LICENSE file (all rights reserved by default); inputs carry their own terms (Inside Airbnb CC BY 4.0, data.boston.gov open, jefftk.com scrapes unlicensed, BARI Dataverse). duplicated_license_listings.csv contains host first names, listing names/descriptions and licence numbers (public IA data, but personal-ish; do not redistribute). Scrape dates include stray 1-7 listing rows on off-dates (e.g. 2018-05-19, 2019-05-24), artefacts of the merge, and 2015-2017 are single annual scrapes. Airbnb price is quoted nightly price, not realised ADR. Repo last pushed 2020-05-25; the linked Flask app (jsfitz.pythonanywhere.com) may be dead.
